title: Bundle Current Pointer (v1)
description: Schema for bundles/<profile-id>/current.json. A small, atomically-rewritten pointer file naming which immutable revision directory (bundles/<profile-id>/<revision-sha256>/) is presently live, plus the previous revision for rollback. Publishing a new revision is staged then atomically swapped; rollback is just re-pointing current to previousRevision — it never deletes or edits revision directories. No Go type defines this file yet; internal/profile.BuildBundlePlan explicitly documents that its plan is dry-run only and does not update current.json. This schema is forward-looking and aligns the pointer's revision fields with the SHA-256 revision identifier used by bundle-lock.schema.json.

currentRevision.description: Must equal an existing bundles/<profileId>/<currentRevision>/ directory's revision hash (see bundle-lock.schema.json).

previousRevision.description: The immediately prior currentRevision, retained for rollback. Null only for a profile's first-ever publish.
